moments.title: Aston Villa in UEFA Super Cup
moments.blurb: English club Aston Villa takes on French giants Paris Saint-Germain in the UEFA Super Cup on August 12th in Salzburg, Austria.

angles.name: Match Build-up
angles.copy: Aston Villa are just eight days away from a huge European showdown! They face PSG in the UEFA Super Cup next Wednesday. Can they bring home the silverware?

angles.name: Fan Excitement
angles.copy: Salzburg is getting ready for the UEFA Super Cup! Aston Villa fans, are you making the trip or planning your watch party for next Wednesday?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield between Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City will be played at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosting
angles.copy: Huge football news for Wales! The FA Community Shield between Arsenal and Man City is coming to Principality Stadium in Cardiff on August 16th. Who's excited for the season curtain-raiser?

angles.name: Local Buzz
angles.copy: Cardiff is gearing up for a massive day of football! The Community Shield brings Arsenal and Man City to Principality Stadium. Will you be there or watching locally?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's duet 'Rein Me In' has set a new UK singles chart record, spending 19 non-consecutive weeks at number one.

angles.name: Chart Record Breakers
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK Number 1 single ever, with 19 non-consecutive weeks! Incredible.

angles.name: Celebrating Success
angles.copy: 19 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean have smashed a 73-year-old record with 'Rein Me In'. What a track!

moments.title: Official Trending Chart Update
moments.blurb: The Official Trending Chart sees new momentum from artists like Silva Bumpa, KETTAMA, and ADÉLA, with Silva Bumpa's 'On 2nite' projected for the Top 10.

angles.name: Future Hits
angles.copy: Who's on their way up? The Official Trending Chart is buzzing with Silva Bumpa, KETTAMA, and ADÉLA making moves this week. Keep an ear out!

angles.name: Silva Bumpa
angles.copy: Could Silva Bumpa be hitting the Top 10 this week? His track 'On 2nite' is flying up the Official Trending Chart!

moments.title: Roots Picnic London Debut
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, this weekend, August 8-9, celebrating hip hop, music, and culture.

angles.name: London Festival
angles.copy: Big weekend ahead for London! The legendary Roots Picnic festival lands at Crystal Palace Bowl this Saturday and Sunday for its international debut. Who's going?

angles.name: Hip Hop Culture
angles.copy: Music, culture, community! Roots Picnic brings its world-renowned hip-hop celebration to London's Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend. Get ready!

moments.title: Happy Birthday John O'Callaghan

angles.name: Rock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 38th Birthday to John O'Callaghan, the awesome frontman of The Maine! What's your favourite track from them?

angles.name: Metal Icon Bday

angles.name: Indie Pop Legend
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Ian Broudie of The Lightning Seeds! So many classic tracks, what's your favourite?
